notes: Batch of 20 Penn clubs, read from the Penn Clubs directory API (one fetch each), plus 10 club websites where the entry linked one, plus 13 re-reads of the directory status fields. Result: 20 records. 11 publish with status (1 active, 10 probably_active). 8 held back as status unknown because the directory status reads INACTIVE: Kurdish Students, La Unidad Latina, Langfitt, Latin and Ballroom Dance, Latinx Coalition, Latter-day Saint Student Association, Medical Volunteers for Prevention, MENA. 1 hidden: MECS at Penn, no public way in. The directory status UNDER REVIEW is an approval state, not an activity flag, so clubs with the active flag set and no dated item are probably_active. Latin and Ballroom Dance and MENA have current-looking evidence on their own pages (Fall 2026 lessons and an October 10, 2026 competition; Fall 2026 membership), and Medical Volunteers lists an open FA26 application, so the reviewer should check those statuses first. The Latinx Coalition's newest dated site item is from 2022, so if it stays inactive it should be dormant. Years are used only where the page writes one. Numeric application_required values were not treated as definitive; records rely on the page text. Langfitt's listed email looks personal and was omitted. Matriculate's national site does not mention Penn. Searches used: 0. Fetches used: 43 of 60. No blocked pages, no rate limiting.
